title: helm-os config
description: Your configuration. Supplies every user-specific value the framework reads (schedule, connectors, projects, voice). Lives in your vault as os.config.json; the framework repo ships none of it.

name.description: The principal the OS works for.

role.description: Job/role; steers the routine preset and vocabulary.

timezone.description: IANA tz, e.g. Asia/Manila. The clock stage reads this.

briefAddressee.description: Who the brief is written to (usually the principal).

org.description: The team or company name the brief uses when a client is waiting on the team.

teamDomain.description: The team's email domain, e.g. example.com. A reply from this domain clears a client ball.

slots.description: Hour (local, 0-23 as string) to mode. Modes: morning, capture, evening.

cron.description: Cron the adapter registers the routine with.

vaultRoot.description: Absolute path to the user's vault. The only absolute path; everything else is resolved relative to it by helm/lib/paths.js.

whatsappDb.description: Path to the WhatsApp bridge's store/messages.db, read-only. Leave out if you have no bridge.

minSends.description: Sends needed before a card can block a draft, and before a person gets their own card. Default 30.

block.description: false = the check only warns. Default true.

cardDir.description: Where the readable cards go. Default Personal/voice in the vault.

voice.description: Voice: your profile file plus measured voice cards from your own sends.

connectors.description: Which tools this user has. Absent connectors are simply skipped by the sweeps.

type.description: telegram | whatsapp | discord | slack | teams | gchat | imessage

readVia.description: browser when the MCP cannot see this board (wrong account, no connector).

browserUrl.description: The board's inbox/notifications URL, read in the logged-in browser when readVia is browser.

note.description: Why this board reads the way it does, shown to the sweep.

projectAliasPattern.description: Shared per-project mailbox pattern, e.g. <project>@example.com. Mail there counts as client venue.

identityIds.description: The user's own ids per connector, used to tell self from others (e.g. Discord authorId/guildId).

whatsapp.description: Your own WhatsApp ids (phone or lid), so notes to self are skipped.

projects.description: The project-map. Each row is a project/mission the generic project-runner and portfolio-health drive.

floor.description: Weekdays of silence before a sweep fires anyway. Overrides the state default.

channels.description: Surfaces the project owns; free text or connector refs.

ledgerTag.description: Source tag written into the shared follow-ups ledger.

bespoke.description: Optional path to a file project that overrides the generic runner.

agentType.description: Optional: a harness subagent type to run this project instead of the generic runner (preserves a hand-tuned project agent).

areas.description: Brief taxonomy: how work is grouped and labeled in the composed brief.

careRanking.description: Priority hierarchy the audio brief weights by, most important first.

ledgerEnforce.description: false = write-ledger shadow mode, true = block duplicates.

audio.description: Audio brief. Needs a Gemini API key in your environment (GEMINI_TTS_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY); the OS never takes the key value, only reads it from the environment.

voice.description: Gemini TTS voice (male: Charon, Puck, Fenrir, Enceladus).

playerArtifactUrl.description: Standing player URL to republish in place; leave empty to mint a new one each run.

writes.description: How the OS writes to external systems. Email and chat are always draft-only. This controls trackers.

tracker.description: draft (default): the OS drafts proposed ticket comments/creates into the project's drafts/ for you to apply. auto: it writes them directly in your voice, gated by the write-ledger.

usage.description: Usage routine: how you work with AI, read from your Claude Code and Codex transcripts. Numbers go to _usage/, anything built from your words stays in _usage/local.nosync/.

enabled.description: Schedule the nightly rollup. Default true.

model.description: Allow the small model calls (one-time labeling, nightly 3-line read). false = zero tokens, numbers only.

osPrefixes.description: Opening words of prompts your automation writes, so they count as the OS and not you.

ownerName.description: Your name as your automation writes it. Defaults to identity.name.

particles.description: Filler words or particles to count, e.g. from a second language.

languages.description: Language name -> word list, for the share of each language in your messages.

projectAliases.description: Project label -> names you type for it.

hubPaths.description: Folders where you work on many projects; sessions there take the project their messages name. The vault is always one.

aliases.description: Person name -> other names for them, on top of the people file.

peopleFile.description: People file, relative to the vault. Default People/people.md.

prices.description: Model id prefix -> { in, out, cacheRead?, cacheWrite? } in USD per million tokens, for models without a built-in price.

codexModel.description: Model for Codex labeling calls, when your default needs a newer CLI.

dayToDay.description: Project labels that are how you run your day, not projects (your OS, admin). They fold into one Day to day row, left out of project rankings and comparisons.
